12/18/2008: Data Collection Enabled: 
 
            - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins: 
 
                 First data report:   Dec 19, 2008 - 00:05 (Day=354) 
 
 
 
12/18/2008: Station Maintenance: 
 
            - Established telecommunication between station cell-modem and 
              data collection PC/server on campus.    
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:   MAWN_ABCW (3-hour power cycle) 
                                        
            - Now able to collect raw weather data. 
 
            - Need to create new database tables/reports for "rvl" 
 
 
11/26/2008: Station Maintenance: 
 
            - Saginaw MAWN station was moved to new location.  The new 
              location is still affiliated with the MSU Saginaw Valley 
              Dry Bean & Sugar Beet Research Farm but is now located 
              near Richville/Frankenmuth and will be known as  
              Richville (RVL)
